steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's so strange, Doctor. We definitely shook off the Sarkaz warriors from before...

options: But they're still coming without end.
It's like they know our position.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Closure, are our communications being traced?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Not a chance, Amiya, I guarantee it! I set up triple-layer encryption on our transmitters! If they had the tech for that, then Theresis would've breached the landship a hundred times over by now!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Doctor, I believe Closure.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They must be using some other method then.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Miss Amiya, we're a stone's throw from the rendezvous point!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: As long as we link up with Team 6, we can get in contact with the subterranean support unit. Once we're underground, the Sarkaz pursuing us will be out of luck.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No, don't go that way.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Huh? Why... wait, what? Miss Siege, what are you doing here?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Weren't you under...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Team 6 is...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Team 6 is what? Why do you look so... erk, Miss Indra, have you seen all that blood on your hands?!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Your soldiers, they... all gave their lives.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Th-That can't be right! Team 6 is still ahead of us, how could they have run into the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We don't have time to analyze how.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Doctor, it wasn't the Sarkaz force pursuing us that killed Team 6's soldiers.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The enemy they faced had terrifying Originium Arts... It was more of a massacre than a battle. Hardly any of them had even drawn their weapons.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You sure it was Originium Arts?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I don't believe that!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I saw this red bug thing tear the soldiers' chests apart. Vina, you saw it too! That was a genuine monster!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...So the perpetrator is no ordinary Sarkaz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to change course. Mr. Feist, are there any other routes we can take?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Yes. But we don't have any support waiting on it. If we run into Sarkaz forces...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We'll be in for another hard fight.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Find cover!

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn, what the hell is this?!

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: What did that Sarkaz throw at us, a bomb? None of us even saw it—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...Originium Arts.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Eyes up!

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: I... I just saw something red flash by in midair!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Retreat!

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: It's like a thunderbolt or something! That's Originium Arts?!

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: These... abominable devils!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Still won't come out?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your war, your battle, your fight, it can't be this game of runabout you're playing, can it White Wolf?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Five aerial blood streaks at once?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn, we have no chance of—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: No matter how strong the Arts... he's only one person.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What did Victoria do in the past, to prevail over the Sarkaz again and again?

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: How many bolts do we have left?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Cover me.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: A pitiful act of defiance—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Now... is our chance.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Counting on an Arts bombardment to make your escape?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I'll give you a rude awakening.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What I said still stands. So long as my soldiers remain here, I will not flee.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Not bad after all, White Wolf. I see you have the bravado to reverse course and charge me.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Such a shame then...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ––Rrgh!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Whoever told you that a Sarkaz depends solely on Arts in a fight?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Even wielding no more than a sword—I can still defeat every last one of you.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Beating me... may not be so difficult...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: But making me fall will... not be so easy.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: How very brave of you.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It's thanks to that valor of yours that I can end this battle that much quicker—
The instant he thrusts his sword out, the soldier before Manfred abruptly vanishes.
She seems to practically dissolve and melt through the wall behind her, leaving not even a ripple.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: These Arts are unfamiliar...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Vigilance!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: ...A dagger from thin air?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: No, not from thin air...
You react very fast.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I'm afraid I'd have one more hole in my chest otherwise.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Target found! Take aim!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What the hell? They vanished again?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Th-They're too fast! I can't land a shot!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Shields up, up! Quick! Shit, are they able to blink?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Blink? No such Arts could be cast without leaving even a trace!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Or is this... a diversion?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Don't let them fool you! All men, cast precision aside! Attack at once!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: So long as the enemy is still in front of us, they have no escape!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Have we... hit them?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, there's no body.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But the ground is shot to hell... Where can they still be hiding?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, behind you!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Show yourself, and your life is mine!
Really?
Manfred, you put it very well, but unfortunately... you were only half right.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Half?
Sarkaz do not depend solely on Arts to fight—
—but in no world do Sarkaz wield swords alone.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Aarrghh!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The ground shouldn't be this soft—this place is going to swallow us! I-I'm losing my grip on my blade!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, you're sinking too?!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: ...Nobody move, and nobody panic.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The dagger is his staff. These are Arts, and nothing more than Arts.
You're very calm-headed. Good... you've saved your men's lives.
However...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Rgh!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The ground's... nearing my stomach...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: My sword...
With your swordsmanship, blocking my attacks would be a simple task.
But the more you struggle, the quicker the ground swallows you.
Is this how you want to go... this self-destruction?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Urgh... *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: No one come near!
Or, you could cease all movements, same as your men.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You want me to wait as you run my heart through?
It'd be tough, killing you.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... *pant*...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I see now. You're not actually here to take my life.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I never imagined that outside of Ascalon, Rhodes Island would have yet another apex Sarkaz assassin.
I'm no assassin.
Unless it's called for, I have zero desire to harm any Sarkaz at all.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: But here you are, abetting our enemies!
Are these Victorians... your enemies?
What I see is a group of bruised, weary warriors, on the soil of their own home, struggling painfully just to live.
You and Theresis, on the other hand, are turning the Sarkaz into the enemy of all.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I had entertained having a talk with your people, if I had the chance.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It's a sorry thing, that we should first meet on the battlefield—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: —Rhodes Island Elite Operator.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: He's gone again? Ngh—the ground's back to normal!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: A hair's breadth.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I was on the cusp of capturing him. His Arts are all too exceptional... He can induce hallucinations without influencing our nervous systems.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: There are marks of energy transformation on the ground. Could it be...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, they're all gone! Those Victoria soldiers, I mean—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Keh... He would visit me and stall for time, just to extricate those half-dead soldiers one by one?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Are... Are we pursuing them, then?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Do you think we can?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I may have called it a hair's breadth, but against a Caster of that level, a hair's breadth is tantamount to guaranteed failure.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Dammit! We were set to clean out all the rebel forces by today! Now a mercenary's gone traitor AND some mystery Caster's held us back!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It's Rhodes Island... This is all because of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: We missed our chance to round them up in their entirety, but their losses can't be light, can they?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: They had their chance to hide in the dark, but now they've been driven front and center. For them, revealing their forces is already a colossal tactical defeat.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: An assassin, an expert spacial illusionist Caster, and the as-yet unseen Banshee... How many cards does Rhodes Island still have up their sleeve?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, what are your plans?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: ...Let us go. Before we deal with Rhodes Island, we first need to put the discontented clown in its place.
This should be far enough for now.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...Is this outside of the factory district?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You... cut open space with your dagger?
Don't always trust your senses. Tricking your eyes is much easier than influencing space.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You've...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You've rescued me, and not just once. My eyes might not show me the truest answers, but my senses never lie.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Just who are you?
Misery. I'm Misery of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: You'll get a chance to hear a full explanation from Bagpipe in due time.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bagpipe?

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: She's a coworker at this point.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Not to mention... the last friend my best friend ever made.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Sounds like I've been quite a bit out of the loop.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: But before I lose myself to the joy that Bagpipe made it out, allow me to once again thank you and Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Let's get out of here first. Chances are we'll be meeting again soon enough.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Manfred's almost worked out the truth of my Originium Arts. He could be coming after us any moment now.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: ...No. I imagine he'll be busy with something else right now.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: You mean Dublinn.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: County Hillock's Mandragora... There's no way she's leaving this factory now.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Are you giving yourself grief for not being able to personally avenge your comrades?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I... I'm just lamenting.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Myself for standing here, regretting that I missed the opportunity to kill her...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Or her, for being long since beyond saving.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: That's odd. This is what you agreed with them, right? Why aren't they here to back us up?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I—argh!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: What the hell is it—?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Sarkaz! It's Sarkaz! We have to run—

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: ...Were we spotted?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: No. Not like this. 'Spy', we have to go—

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Only ten meters to that sliding door there, right? Just ten meters, and we're right out, and...

steps.name: Taran Secret Agent
steps.text: A... Alright, let's run...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Just like we used to, you pulling me. We only had to run fast enough that those noble kids couldn't catch us...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Grotesques! Get down, block them!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Bastards! Can't even rely on you in a time like this?

steps.name: Taran Secret Agent
steps.text: Mandragora...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: What? Didn't I tell you to stay quiet for now?

steps.name: Taran Secret Agent
steps.text: I can't keep walking. You go.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: What...? Can't you see? I've been doing all this just to...

steps.name: Taran Secret Agent
steps.text: To save me? Or to gain favor with the Leader?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Is there a difference? What are you talking about? We're just five meters away, our people are right outside!

steps.name: Taran Secret Agent
steps.text: They're gone.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Taran Secret Agent
steps.text: Mandragora... The Leader... she's long since abandoned us...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: 'Spy'!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Bastard, bastard—stones, go! Skewer them, impale every one of those Sarkaz!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You'll be alright, 'Spy', it's just an arrow, we're three meters away, even if I have to carry you—

steps.name: Taran Secret Agent
steps.text: ...Just go.

steps.name: Taran Secret Agent
steps.text: If you can make it out...

steps.name: Taran Secret Agent
steps.text: Don't... Don't head for the Leader.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: ...Did you just die?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Who said you could die so easily...? I...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Cillian, Cillian... you bloody disgrace! I'm not letting you die here, you stand up for me, stand up!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: No need to work yourself up.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You won't live much longer either, Mandragora. You and your old Taran friend will meet again before you know it.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Ha... hahahaha!

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Manfred, you cost me another eleven lives.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You don't know the half... you don't know anything of what it took to kill that many Sarkaz.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: ...This is exactly why you must die here.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Perfect... drop yourselves right in my lap.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I'll crush every one of you into paste, no prisoners.
